⚠️Traffic Advisory⚠️ 

Spring St between Temple and 1st St.  

A permitted demonstration is now in progress.  Expect delays in the Civic Center part of DTLA.  Thousands of participants are expected.  Traffic will be impacted.  Several streets in the area may be closed.
